sloka: सुरा चानीयतां क्षिप्रं सर्वशोकविनाशिनी ।मानुषं मांसमासाद्य नृत्यामोऽथ निकुम्भिलाम् ।। ५.२२.४१।।।।
transliteration: surā cānīyatāṁ kṣipraṁ sarvaśokavināśinī ।mānuṣaṁ māṁsamāsādya nṛtyāmo'tha nikumbhilām ।। 5.22.41।।।।

translations.english: "O king surely she is not ordained by Brahma, the foremost among the immortals to enjoy the luxuries earned by the strength of your arms.
